# glb-mobile-performance-budget (reference summary)

## Purpose
Set explicit triangle / texture / draw-call / file-size / animation budgets for GLB targeted at mobile-web before any export decision.

Translate "make it work on mobile" intent into a concrete numeric planning ceiling table (triangles, vertices, GLB file size, texture pixels, materials, draw calls, animation channels, bones, morph targets) per device tier, scene scope, and target context. Pin this budget before scene mutation so downstream scene planners consume it, `polycount-budget-checker` and `material-quality-checker` validate counts and textures against it, `render-export-evidence` measures compliance, `glb-web-handoff` consumes it for web delivery, and `glb-animation-handoff` owns animation contracts.

## Metadata & truth boundary
- **Canonical skill:** `skills/glb-mobile-performance-budget/SKILL.md`
- **Contract:** `skills/glb-mobile-performance-budget/contract.json` (`v1.0.0`)
- **Category / role:** `evidence-and-handoff` / `mobile-webgl-budget-validator`
- **Capability tier:** `L0`
- **Truth-state policy:** Runtime status defaults to `Not Run`; Artifact status defaults to `Not Produced`; mutation rule is `downgrade_only` (never upgrade without verified evidence).

## When to use
- before scene plan is locked
- before any GLB export attempt
- when user says "for mobile" / "for the web" / "phone" / "low-end devices"
- when designing a scene that must run alongside other web content

## Trigger cues
- "what's a good polycount for mobile"
- "how big can the GLB be"
- "will this load on iPhone"
- "what should I aim for on a phone"

## When not to use
- desktop-only renders without web handoff → delegate to `polycount-budget-checker` (`references/skills/polycount-budget-checker.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to polycount-budget-checker)
- offline pre-rendered video (no real-time budget needed) → delegate to `material-quality-checker` (`references/skills/material-quality-checker.md`; no real-time budget needed)
- replacing engineering load testing (this skill sets a planning budget, not a real-world benchmark) → delegate to `glb-web-handoff` (`references/skills/glb-web-handoff.md`; this skill sets a planning budget, not a real-world benchmark)

## Inputs & output/evidence contract
### Required inputs
- `target_device_tier_and_network` (`string`): Target mobile/web hardware tier (iOS Safari, mid-range Android, desktop WebGL) and load budget
- `scene_deliverable_type` (`string`): Whether the GLB is a single hero product, multi-item configurator, or animated character

### Optional inputs
- `compression_pipeline_support` (`object`): Whether the host app supports Draco, Meshopt, or KTX2 BasisU transcoding

### Primary outputs
- `pinned_glb_performance_budget_table`
- `triangle_drawcall_and_texture_ceilings`
- `compression_and_lod_requirements`

## Quick-start procedure
1. pick the device tier (low-end Android, mid-mobile, high-mobile, desktop-fallback)
2. read the budget row for that tier
3. pin the budget into the scene plan before mutation
4. treat any later violation as a blocker, not a warning
